facts.fact: UNDP Somalia says a Baidoa pilot with NIRA registered 38,026 internally displaced people for the national ID in one month.
UNDP Somalia says displaced people in Baidoa enrolled in the national digital ID system, and that from January 2026 the ID will be required for services such as opening a bank account.
UNDP Somalia counts 38,026 internally displaced people enrolled in the national ID in the Baidoa pilot, against 500,000 IDPs in Baidoa.
